**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Unsupported native tag
```

## How to fix

Use a valid HTML/SVG/MathML tag name, a custom element with a hyphen (`<my-el>`), or a capitalized component name (`<MyEl />`).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <x$y />;
```

```tsx prefer
export const A = () => <x-y />;
```

## When it is reported

Message omits the tag name.
